topic: The first landing on the Moon's far side
script: In 2019, China landed the first spacecraft on the far side of the Moon. The mission was called Chang'e 4, and it carried a rover named Yutu-2. Because the far side never faces Earth, it cannot talk to us directly. So a relay satellite called Queqiao passed messages back and forth. In 2024, Chang'e 6 brought the first rock samples from the far side back to Earth. The far side is covered in many more craters than the side we see.
